title: Listing reader: six complete capabilities
description: Declare this exact profile before an audit. All six criteria remain in the denominator. This measures the stated listing-reader behaviors, not compliance with every part of a NIP, production adoption, financial safety, or overall marketplace quality.
applicability: A client component that discovers and displays marketplace listings. State its declared listing variant and app configuration in the report. Evaluate other roles under separate profiles.

scoring.0: Verified unavailability in the audited scope, or a recorded behavior test that genuinely fails the criterion. Missing searches and environment failures do not qualify.
scoring.1: Complete, reachable implemented source trace for this criterion, with no contradictory evidence; behavior execution is not run or blocked.
scoring.2: Complete, reachable implementation plus a recorded passing behavior test for this criterion.
scoring.null: Unknown, unexamined, documentation-only, partial, conflicting, or blocked without a complete implementation trace.

criteria.description: Discover candidate listings from the declared source and route them into a reachable listing-reader workflow; record relay, query, index, and filtering assumptions.

Parse and render the declared minimum listing contract in a reachable consumer, without substituting a fixture-only parser for the application path. State the required fields and malformed-input behavior.
Interpret amount, denomination/currency, and optional frequency according to the declared listing variant, including missing or invalid price handling. A formatted number alone is insufficient.

Resolve listing identity using the full address required by the declared variant; for addressable Nostr events this includes kind, author, and d identifier. Do not confuse the current event ID with a stable listing address.

Apply valid listing revisions and resolve competing versions according to the declared contract, while preserving listing identity and preventing an older event from overwriting a newer accepted version.

Honor the declared listing-withdrawal variant in discovery and display. The variant may use a sold/inactive status, a valid deletion request, or another explicit convention. Name and assess that complete variant; this profile mandates no particular commerce protocol and does not imply remote erasure.
